posts.zh:
dsh-window#plugin 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 的 Windows 原生窗口（WebView2）：一键安装，自动从 GitHub Releases 下载应用 zip、创建桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b3d878f1ed60a0d3497c.html
posts.en:
dsh-window#plugin is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Native Windows desktop window (WebView2) for DSH: one-command install, auto-fetches the app zip from GitHub Releases, creates a desktop shortcut, and adds a desktop_launch tool to start it from chat.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b3d878f1ed60a0d3497c.html
